item.title: Welcome!
item.dc:creator: Dutch Development Economics Network
item.description:
The Dutch Development Economics Network is launching a new website!

This is where you will find our upcoming and past events, the universities and members that make up the network and, here on the blog, news and ideas from across our community.

We look forward to the many contributions of knowledge and thought from our members. Have something to share? Get in touch and write a post for the blog.
